summary: All three new tests are load-bearing and value-based. The on_start_entry_null test asserts the exact translated string 'Старт не з'єднано — проведіть ребро до кроку' AND negates the 'видалено' substring — two distinct assertions that would fail against the pre-fix generic message and against a future regression merging the messages. The missing_target test asserts the exact translated string 'Зламане з'єднання — ціль видалено', passing only when the reason-to-key dispatch routes correctly. The clear/no-banner test asserts absence of the broken-edges container for a fully-wired on_start, which is a true negative that would fail if the fix accidentally suppressed the banner for wrong reasons. Litmus test: removing BROKEN_EDGE_MESSAGE_KEYS or the brokenEdgeMessageKey dispatch in the Vue component collapses both reason-specific strings to the generic 'funnels.canvas.brokenEdge' key, causing the exact-string assertions to fail — tests are genuinely load-bearing. required-keys.spec.ts adds the two new i18n keys to REQUIRED_KEYS and to NON_EMPTY_REQUIRED_KEYS (via the funnels.canvas.* filter), so both locale files are checked for presence AND non-empty value — behaviorally stronger than key-presence alone. No existing tests are weakened; the new tests use independent mountWith calls with distinct prop configurations. Test pyramid: all additions are component unit tests (mountSuspended), consistent with the existing file's approach for a UI-heavy canvas component. No coverage gaps identified for the stated fix scope.
